2	"""
3	brand-check.py — AZMX brand linter.
4	
5	Checks .html / .css / .md / .svg files against the AZMX brand system:
6	
7	  1. Hex colours outside the legal palette (nearest legal token suggested)
8	  2. Non-brand font-family declarations
9	  3. font-style: italic / oblique  (the serif has no italic; it renders faux-slanted)
10	  4. padding / margin / gap px values off the 8-16-24-40-64-96-128-160 scale
11	  5. Electric #001AFF as text on a dark surface, or as a large fill behind text
12	  6. Chevron / arrow art used as background decoration or at low opacity
13	
14	The legal palette is parsed from references/colors.md AT RUNTIME, so the linter
15	never goes stale when the brand changes.
16	
17	Usage:
18	    python3 scripts/brand-check.py [file-or-dir ...] [--quiet]
19	
20	With no paths it scans the whole repo. Exits 1 if any blocker was found.
21	"""

90	def norm_hex(raw: str) -> str | None:
91	    """Normalise a hex token to #RRGGBB. Returns None if it carries alpha 0."""
92	    h = raw.lstrip("#")
93	    if len(h) in (3, 4):
94	        h = "".join(c * 2 for c in h[:3])
95	    elif len(h) in (6, 8):
96	        h = h[:6]
97	    else:
98	        return None
99	    return "#" + h.upper()
100	
101	
102	def rgb(hex6: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
103	    h = hex6.lstrip("#")
104	    return int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
105	
106	
107	def luminance(hex6: str) -> float:
108	    """Relative luminance, 0-1."""
109	    def lin(c: float) -> float:
110	        c /= 255.0
111	        return c / 12.92 if c <= 0.04045 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4
112	    r, g, b = rgb(hex6)
113	    return 0.2126 * lin(r) + 0.7152 * lin(g) + 0.0722 * lin(b)
114	
115	
116	class Palette:
117	    def __init__(self, legal: dict[str, str], source: str):
118	        self.legal = legal              # #RRGGBB -> token name
119	        self.source = source
120	
121	    def is_legal(self, hex6: str) -> bool:
122	        return hex6 in self.legal
123	
124	    def name(self, hex6: str) -> str:
125	        return self.legal.get(hex6, hex6)
126	
127	    def nearest(self, hex6: str) -> tuple[str, str, float]:
128	        r1, g1, b1 = rgb(hex6)
129	        best, bestd = None, 1e9
130	        for cand in self.legal:
131	            r2, g2, b2 = rgb(cand)
132	            d = ((r1 - r2) ** 2 + (g1 - g2) ** 2 + (b1 - b2) ** 2) ** 0.5
133	            if d < bestd:
134	                best, bestd = cand, d
135	        return best, self.legal[best], bestd
136	
137	
138	def find_colors_md(start: str) -> str | None:
139	    """Walk up from a path looking for references/colors.md."""
140	    cur = os.path.abspath(start)
141	    if os.path.isfile(cur):
142	        cur = os.path.dirname(cur)
143	    while True:
144	        cand = os.path.join(cur, "references", "colors.md")
145	        if os.path.isfile(cand):
146	            return cand
147	        parent = os.path.dirname(cur)
148	        if parent == cur:
149	            return None
150	        cur = parent
151	
152	
153	def load_palette(colors_md: str) -> Palette:
154	    """
155	    Parse every hex in the markdown tables. Rows carrying exactly one hex also
156	    donate their first cell as the token name.
157	    """
158	    legal: dict[str, str] = {}
159	    with open(colors_md, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
160	        for line in fh:
161	            hexes = [norm_hex(m.group(0)) for m in HEX_RE.finditer(line)]
162	            hexes = [h for h in hexes if h]
163	            if not hexes:
164	                continue
165	            token = None
166	            if line.lstrip().startswith("|"):
167	                cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
168	                if cells:
169	                    token = re.sub(r"[`*]", "", cells[0]).strip()
170	                    if not token or HEX_RE.search(token):
171	                        token = None
172	            for h in hexes:
173	                if h not in legal or (token and len(hexes) == 1):
174	                    legal[h] = token if (token and len(hexes) == 1) else legal.get(h, h)
175	    if not legal:
176	        raise SystemExit(f"brand-check: no hex values found in {colors_md}")
177	    return Palette(legal, colors_md)

212	    out = list(css)

214	        for i in range(m.start(), m.end()):

- [ ] Reports are available in JSON, HTML, and markdown formats
- [ ] Reports include: total files scanned, pass/fail rate, violations by category (color, font, spacing, copy), severity distribution, and top 5 most common violations
- [ ] HTML report is self-contained (no external dependencies) and visually presentable
- [ ] Reports can be generated for visual checks, copy checks, or both combined
- [ ] Historical report data can be stored and compared to show trends over time
- [ ] Report generation completes in under 30 seconds for 100 files

3	Extend brand-check.py to generate comprehensive compliance reports in JSON, HTML, and markdown formats. 3	brand-check.py — AZMX brand linter.
4

6	
7	  1. Hex colours outside the legal palette (nearest legal token suggested)
8	  2. Non-brand font-family declarations
9	  3. font-style: italic / oblique  (the serif has no italic; it renders faux-slanted)
10	  4. padding / margin / gap px values off the 8-16-24-40-64-96-128-160 scale
11	  5. Electric #001AFF as text on a dark surface, or as a large fill behind text
12	  6. Chevron / arrow art used as background decoration or at low opacity
13	
14	The legal palette is parsed from references/colors.md AT RUNTIME, so the linter
15	never goes stale when the brand changes.
16	
17	Usage:
18	    python3 scripts/brand-check.py [file-or-dir ...] [--quiet]
19	
20	With no paths it scans the whole repo. Exits 1 if any blocker was found.
21	"""

108	    """Relative luminance, 0-1."""
109	    def lin(c: float) -> float:
110	        c /= 255.0
111	        return c / 12.92 if c <= 0.04045 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4
112	    r, g, b = rgb(hex6)

133	            if d < bestd:

2	"""
3	brand-check.py — AZMX brand linter.
4	
5	Checks .html / .css / .md / .svg files against the AZMX brand system:
6	
7	  1. Hex colours outside the legal palette (nearest legal token suggested)
8	  2. Non-brand font-family declarations
9	  3. font-style: italic / oblique  (the serif has no italic; it renders faux-slanted)
10	  4. padding / margin / gap px values off the 8-16-24-40-64-96-128-160 scale
11	  5. Electric #001AFF as text on a dark surface, or as a large fill behind text
12	  6. Chevron / arrow art used as background decoration or at low opacity
13	
14	The legal palette is parsed from references/colors.md AT RUNTIME, so the linter
15	never goes stale when the brand changes.
16	
17	Usage:
18	    python3 scripts/brand-check.py [file-or-dir ...] [--quiet] [--report]
19	
20	With no paths it scans the whole repo. Exits 1 if any blocker was found.
21	The --report flag outputs an aggregated compliance summary instead of detailed findings.

93	    h = raw.lstrip("#")
94	    if len(h) in (3, 4):
95	        h = "".join(c * 2 for c in h[:3])
96	    elif len(h) in (6, 8):
97	        h = h[:6]
98	    else:

103	def rgb(hex6: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
104	    h = hex6.lstrip("#")
105	    return int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
106	
107	
108	def luminance(hex6: str) -> float:
109	    """Relative luminance, 0-1."""
110	    def lin(c: float) -> float:
111	        c /= 255.0
112	        return c / 12.92 if c <= 0.04045 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4
113	    r, g, b = rgb(hex6)
114	    return 0.2126 * lin(r) + 0.7152 * lin(g) + 0.0722 * lin(b)

117	class Palette:
118	    def __init__(self, legal: dict[str, str], source: str):
119	        self.legal = legal              # #RRGGBB -> token name
120	        self.source = source

123	        return hex6 in self.legal
124	
125	    def name(self, hex6: str) -> str:
126	        return self.legal.get(hex6, hex6)

129	        r1, g1, b1 = rgb(hex6)
130	        best, bestd = None, 1e9
131	        for cand in self.legal:
132	            r2, g2, b2 = rgb(cand)
133	            d = ((r1 - r2) ** 2 + (g1 - g2) ** 2 + (b1 - b2) ** 2) ** 0.5
134	            if d < bestd:
135	                best, bestd = cand, d
136	        return best, self.legal[best], bestd

140	    """Walk up from a path looking for references/colors.md."""
141	    cur = os.path.abspath(start)

147	            return cand

154	def load_palette(colors_md: str) -> Palette:
155	    """
156	    Parse every hex in the markdown tables. Rows carrying exactly one hex also
157	    donate their first cell as the token name.
158	    """
159	    legal: dict[str, str] = {}
160	    with open(colors_md, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
161	        for line in fh:
162	            hexes = [norm_hex(m.group(0)) for m in HEX_RE.finditer(line)]
163	            hexes = [h for h in hexes if h]
164	            if not hexes:

166	            token = None
167	            if line.lstrip().startswith("|"):
168	                cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
169	                if cells:

171	                    if not token or HEX_RE.search(token):

173	            for h in hexes:
174	                if h not in legal or (token and len(hexes) == 1):
175	                    legal[h] = token if (token and len(hexes) == 1) else legal.get(h, h)
176	    if not legal:
177	        raise SystemExit(f"brand-check: no hex values found in {colors_md}")
178	    return Palette(legal, colors_md)
